context: Asuka lectures on knowledge as a system.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: lecture; vocabulary (体系/性能/至る/伴う/充分) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 知識は、体系として学ぶと身につきます。
lines.en: Knowledge sticks when learned as a system.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 体系を作るのは、難しいですか?
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 体系には、努力が伴います。
lines.en: A system is accompanied by effort.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 理解に至るまで、時間がかかりますね。
lines.en: It takes time to reach understanding.
lines.style: thoughtful adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 充分に時間をかければ、理解に至ります。
lines.en: With enough time, you reach understanding.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 道具の性能も、関係しますか?
lines.style: curious adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 性能の良い辞書は、学びを助けます。
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 体系的に、充分学びたいです。
lines.en: I want to learn systematically and fully.
lines.style: resolved adult student voice, soft warm realization throughout
